instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: Alright, looking at the 2x2 grid, you're going to take one blue brick with the long side facing you and place that on the back two squares of the 2x2 grid. Next you're going to take one red column brick and you're going to place it on the left half of the blue brick that you just placed down. So looking at it from your perspective, it will look like a capital letter L. And then lastly, you'll take one additional red brick and place it directly on top of the red brick that you just placed down. So you have one blue brick and then two red column bricks stacked on top of it.

assumptions: The blue block's 'long side facing you' instruction was interpreted as its length being oriented along the x-axis, consistent with its placement on the 'back two squares' and forming an 'L' shape, rather than its 4-unit face being visible from the viewer's perspective, which would conflict with the specified grid placement.
The first red block was placed at the back-left corner of the blue block's footprint (x=0, z=0) to form the vertical arm of the 'L' shape.
evidence: one blue brick with the long side facing you and place that on the back two squares of the 2x2 grid
one red column brick and you're going to place it on the left half of the blue brick that you just placed down
